info.title: ChayXanh Content Moderation
info.description: Local text and image moderation. JWT protects BE; X-Internal-Api-Key protects the AI operations with their own server URL. Uploaded post images (blog attachments and uploaded video thumbnails) are moderated one by one; video files, YouTube content and YouTube thumbnails are not scanned. Attachments must be files returned by POST /api/v1/upload/post-media and video links must be YouTube, so outside links are rejected with 400. No historical backfill, threshold hiding or notification expansion. See CONTENT_MODERATION.md.

ModerationResult.title: ContentModerationResult
ModerationResult.description: ALLOW requires empty categories/evidence; REVIEW requires both non-empty. Evidence must occur verbatim in title/content; unknown ingredients are not invented. Real modelName and policyVersion are saved on the job.

ModerationImageFinding.description: Verdict for one uploaded image. MODERATION_IMAGE_UNREADABLE (missing, corrupt or over 10 MB) is always REVIEW with empty categories so an administrator checks the file.

StoredModerationResult.description: Saved job verdict. Text-only content keeps the ModerationResult shape. When the post had uploaded images (attachments or an uploaded video thumbnail), imageFindings lists them in order; any REVIEW image makes the whole post REVIEW, categories become the union, and reason is prefixed 'Ảnh N:' when only images were flagged (evidence may then be empty).

url.description: Only paths returned by POST /api/v1/upload/post-media; outside links are rejected.
Only paths returned by POST /api/v1/upload/post-media; outside links are rejected.

contentVersion.description: Required for moderated content (version >0). Send the moderationVersion shown in the queue.

AdminDecision.description: Admin role 1. contentVersion is required and must match when the current moderationVersion is >0; omission is accepted only for legacy version 0 with atomic version matching. Missing/stale/deleted/resolved decisions return 409. REJECT/REMOVE/DELETE soft-delete. Notes max 500.

ModerationJob.description: No full content snapshots, userId or lease fields. applied records a historical application, not current visibility.

targetStatus.description: Current content status, including PENDING_MODERATION, PUBLISHED/ACTIVE, HIDDEN_BY_AI, HIDDEN, DELETED.

totalFlagged.description: Legacy field counts every queued item, including pending/failed scans.

ImageModerationRequest.title: ImageModerationRequest
ImageModerationRequest.description: One server-uploaded post image (index 0–6) with the post text as untrusted context. Decoded size ≤10 MiB and the file header must match mimeType.

ImageModerationResult.title: ImageModerationResult
ImageModerationResult.description: REVIEW requires at least one category and one visible observation; ALLOW has no categories. At most five observations are returned. Real modelName and policyVersion are reported.

video_url.description: HTTPS YouTube link (watch, youtu.be, shorts or embed, no playlist); saved as https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>.

thumbnail_url.description: Empty, a /uploads/posts/<name>.<jpg|jpeg|png|webp|gif> path from post-media upload (moderated as an image), or an https://img.youtube.com or https://i.ytimg.com /vi/<id>/ thumbnail (not moderated).
